description: leadli.me attributes visits from Meta Ads and TikTok Ads to confirmed joins in public Telegram channels and bot starts, then sends server-side conversion events back to those ad platforms. It also provides landing-page tracking and MCP-based management/reporting for channels, bots, attribution, and subscriber reports.
summary: leadli.me exposes a public read-only HTTP discovery API at `https://leadli.me` with OpenAPI at `https://leadli.me/openapi.json`, plus an authenticated Streamable HTTP MCP server at `https://api.leadli.me/api/v1/mcp` using an organization access key in `Authorization: Bearer …`.
